output.subject: We've received your complaint about the Sawmill Pkwy branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to write to us. We have received your complaint and want you to know that a person has read it carefully.

You told us that when you visited the Sawmill Pkwy branch at lunchtime on Friday, September 11, there was only one teller serving a line that reached out the door, while two other employees were chatting at the desks. You mentioned that when you asked why only one window was open, the assistant manager replied "we're short today" without looking up from her screen, and that when you asked to speak with someone else, you were told no one else was available. You also shared that you have been a customer of that branch since it opened, that you feel the service has declined, and that you are considering moving to a different branch.

You also mentioned noticing two overdraft fees on your statement for the same check (#1785).

We're sorry for the frustration this visit caused you. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint, and we will respond within 10 business days.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check the account history for check #1785 to confirm whether two overdraft fees were charged for it and decide what, if anything, to offer.
Confirm with the Sawmill Pkwy branch the staffing on Friday, September 11 at lunchtime and the assistant manager's account of the exchange.
Decide how to address the customer's request to speak with someone else, which was refused at the branch.
The customer says they may move to a different branch; consider whether any retention follow-up is appropriate.
Confirm the visit date (Friday, September 11) matches the year in question before referencing it in any follow-up.
